summary: Frontend-only testing of the new dynamic Equipment feature (iteration 8). Verified defaults, add preset (dumbbells, pull-up bar, kettlebell), remove, custom equipment, merge into Today/Week (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday), hide-on-remove (bands), NEW badges via addon logic, and History rendering. 11 of 12 flows PASS. 1 real bug found: 'Reset All App Data' does NOT reset equipment to defaults.

ui_bugs.issue: clearAllData() in /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js only removes 'homeshred:sessions' and 'homeshred:settings' but does NOT remove 'homeshred:equipment'. After confirming reset, the equipment list retains previously added items (observed 9 rows including Dumbbells, Pull-Up Bar, Kettlebell, Sandbag instead of the expected 6 defaults). Requirement explicitly states reset should restore equipment to defaults.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Chart still renders but container may briefly have zero dimensions on mount.

action_items: Fix clearAllData() in /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js to also remove localStorage key 'homeshred:equipment' (or import the equipment KEY constant / call a dedicated resetEquipment helper). After reset, loadEquipment() should return the 6 DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT_IDS.
critical_code_review_comments: Reset flow does not clear the equipment key — inconsistent with the app's 'reset restores defaults' contract.
Recharts container in History renders with -1/-1 initial size, producing console warnings — consider adding minHeight or fixed dimensions to the ResponsiveContainer parent.
loadEquipment() is called in a useMemo keyed only by `tick` in Today.jsx/Week.jsx — works because Settings calls onTick() after each add/remove, which is correct. Good pattern.
seed_data_creation: None — tests started from localStorage.clear() and use fresh defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only failing check: after clicking reset-confirm-yes, equipment list contains previously added items instead of resetting to 6 defaults (mat, rope, ab-wheel, stepper, bands, shoes). All merge/hide flows (dumbbells → Mon 9 exercises, pullup-bar → Tue Pull-Ups+Chin-Ups, kettlebell → Thu Kettlebell Swings+Goblet Squats, bands removal → Band Front Raise disappears on Mon), custom equipment (Sandbag), and Week screen filtering all verified working. Use page.add_init_script('Date.prototype.getDay = function(){return N;};') then page.reload() to force days.
rca of the issue: clearAllData() in /app/frontend/src/lib/storage.js removes SESSIONS_KEY and SETTINGS_KEY but the equipment KEY 'homeshred:equipment' lives in /app/frontend/src/lib/equipment.js and is never wiped. Fix: either import the KEY into storage.js and remove it in clearAllData, or add localStorage.removeItem('homeshred:equipment') directly. Reproduction: fresh install → add Dumbbells → Settings › Reset All App Data → Confirm → equipment-list still shows dumbbells row + others. Mitigation as above.
